title: AutoRestarter
description: A simple mod that allows you to restart your server on a timer or on a specified day of the week.
body:
Hello! It's AutoRestarter! This mod allows you to restart your fabric server. That's all! Enjoy it!

If you want to restart your server (for example every 12 hrs) please enable "autoRestart" on autorestarter_config.json and and specify the value in seconds equivalent to 12 hours (1 hr = 3600 seconds) on "autoRestartDelaySeconds" **and disable "useScheduledRestart"!!!!**

If you need to restart your server (for example every Sunday at 4.00) just change "autoRestart" = false and enable "useScheduledRestart". Then insert this (
"Sunday 04:00",
"Wednesday 14:49") into “weeklySchedule” and change the values to your own.

That's all about settings.
